description: Prerequisite: caller holds admin rights. Effect: sends ModerationRequest{BAN_USER, EntityId=target_persist_id} on the city socket. Server sets fso_users.is_banned=1 on the target's user row and closes their live session. Cost: none. Persistent DB mutation — target cannot log in again until unbanned. The server refuses to ban another admin/moderator. No response PDU. Non-admin callers refused deterministically in the bot handler.

args.name: target_persist_id
args.description: avatar_id (Sim persist id) of the user to ban.

call_signatures: cf $CF ban-user --target_persist_id <avatar_id>                                      # admin-only; fso_users.is_banned=1 and close session
common_mistakes: Ban is permanent until unban; no wire ACK — verify via fso_users.is_banned DB column.
perception_hints: Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id (for physically-present targets); other avatars need find-avatar or direct knowledge of avatar_id
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-target): perception.avatar.persist_id
Chat activity you may want to moderate: perception.recent_events[] kind=='chat'
